summary: Intermap Technologies filed a 6-K attaching a Canadian Form 51-102F3 material change report disclosing completion on October 7, 2026 of its acquisition of all remaining PCI Geomatics Group shares. The plan of arrangement under the Canada Business Corporations Act (the Canadian equivalent of a court-approved scheme/merger) followed a July 28, 2026 arrangement agreement with PCI and Grenadier Investments, a major PCI shareholder. Aggregate cash consideration was C$11,000,000 less transaction expenses, with C$150,000 escrowed for purchase-price adjustments and C$1,100,000 escrowed for indemnities. PCI CEO June McAlarey continues, adding Intermap EVP duties; watch integration risk and escrow recoveries.
